SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of container offices for Agra. We build each unit to order at our own factory and dispatch it ready to use to the Sikandra Industrial Area, the Foundry Nagar belt and project sites across Agra. You deal with the maker, not a reseller. Browse our full Container Office Supplier for Agra Foundry Nagar range for models, sizes and finishes.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. It reaches you fully finished — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — so a unit or a project team can move in the day it lands. No site masonry, no wet work, no long build wait.

Who buys a container office in Agra

Agra runs on iron foundries and engineering units, footwear and leather, small manufacturing, plus a steady flow of hotel, tourism-infrastructure and real-estate projects. Most enquiries reach us from:

  • Sikandra and Foundry Nagar units needing an admin or supervisor cabin
  • Footwear and small-manufacturing units needing a compact office cabin
  • Contractors on hotel, road and real-estate projects needing a site office
  • Warehouses and yards on the expressway belt needing a gate or dispatch office

These are administrative and site cabins — clean, insulated work spaces, not process or storage structures.

Where we deliver in and around Agra

We supply container offices across the main industrial pockets of Agra:

  • Sikandra Industrial Area (UPSIDC, Sides A–F) — 282007
  • Foundry Nagar industrial belt — 282006
  • Nunhai and the Trans-Yamuna Industrial Estate — 282006

Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftStandard admin or unit officeMost common for Sikandra units
40 ftLarge office or contractor site cabinCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation. Running a hotel or road project? Ask for a construction site office for hotel and real-estate projects.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Agra uses the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with GI sheet
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price stays honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your unit or project works. Common additions for Agra sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Greater Noida factory

Agra is served from our Greater Noida factory on North-zone dispatch. The road route runs almost entirely on the Yamuna Expressway straight into Agra — roughly 165–190 km depending on your plot, which makes it the cleanest single-corridor run in the region. Transit is typically within our standard 3–5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; long-haul cost and crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the region? See our Delhi container office page for NCR projects, container offices we send down the Agra–Jaipur corridor, and container offices we supply across the Kanpur belt.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Agra

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size, panel type, insulation, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the Yamuna Expressway delivery distance to Agra. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Agra?

There is no single fixed price. Cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Agra site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote.

Do you deliver to Sikandra and Foundry Nagar in Agra?

Yes. We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory on the Yamuna Expressway to the Sikandra Industrial Area, Foundry Nagar and the Trans-Yamuna belt — about 165–190 km. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

Do you supply site offices for hotel and real-estate projects?

Yes. A 20 ft or 40 ft container cabin works well as a contractor or project site office for hotel, road and real-estate work, with partitions and electricals to suit. Sizes and layout are confirmed at quotation.

What size suits a foundry or footwear unit admin cabin?

We build 10 ft, 20 ft and 40 ft standard units. A 20 ft cabin covers most admin and supervisor needs, while 10 ft suits a gate or single-desk point and 40 ft suits a larger office. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your container office in Agra, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
